summary.text: David Jenkins was elected to the Georgia House of Representatives in 2020 and represents District 136, covering parts of Coweta, Meriwether and Troup counties.

paragraphs.text: Jenkins enlisted in the U.S. Army after high school, flew Chinook helicopters including combat missions in Iraq and Afghanistan, and retired as a captain in 2015.
Jenkins earned a bachelor's degree at Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University and runs Jenkins Farms in Grantville.
